comparison_rules.normal: Two SHOW CREATE serializations agree on column CHARACTER SET presentation while metadata remains utf8mb4/utf8mb4_unicode_ci.
comparison_rules.same_target_anomaly: First column has COLLATE only, recreated column gains CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 although metadata unchanged.
comparison_rules.case_gates: metadata_difference; compare same table name and column line, ignore whitespace; no wrong-result inference.
comparison_rules.unknown: Syntax/unsupported feature errors, failed setup/postcheck, timeouts/OOM/connection errors, mismatching environment, uncomparable plan or any other unexplained result are unknown; never normal.
comparison_rules.conclusion: Previous normal plus validated target abnormal => observed_new_at_release; same anomaly on previous => pre_existing; otherwise unknown.
